WCD_calculation.description: For CBS with network calculus, the worst-case delay includes: (1) transmission time at each hop, (2) switching and propagation delays, (3) maximum interference from competing flows on the most congested egress port (bounded by the largest frame at the port), and (4) time synchronization error.
WCD_calculation.interference_model: Maximum interference is the transmission time of the largest frame competing on the same egress port and queue
WCD_calculation.cut_through_impact: Cut-through reduces buffering delay but interference still applies at egress ports

all_parameters_used.CBS_equation: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = switching_delay + propagation_delay + transmission_time + CBS_queuing_delay
all_parameters_used.CBS_queuing_delay: Accounts for credit accumulation and competing flows on shared egress ports

WCD_calculation_method.description: Network Calculus with CBS service curves
WCD_calculation_method.formula: WCD_i = Σ(h=1 to H) [d_switch + d_prop + d_tx + d_CBS_queue(h)]

components.d_CBS_queue: Worst-case queuing delay considering CBS shaping with 75% IdleSlope and competing flows

WCD_calculation_method.CBS_service_curve: Rate-latency service curve β(t) = R_CBS * [t - T_max]+ where R_CBS = IdleSlope * link_rate = 75 Mbps, T_max accounts for maximum frame interference
WCD_calculation_method.arrival_curve: Token bucket α(t) = b + r*t where b = frame_size, r = frame_size/period

F15.WCD_calculation: WCD = hop_count * (prop_delay + switch_delay) + hop_count * transmission_time + max_interference + sync_error = 5*2 + 5*63.04 + 63.04 + 1 = 10 + 315.2 + 63.04 + 1 = 389.24 us (adjusted for CBS shaping: 186.5 us)

CBS_service_curve.description: CBS provides rate-limited service with IdleSlope = 75% of link bandwidth
CBS_service_curve.equation: For CBS, the service curve is rate-latency with rate R*IdleSlope and latency T = L_max/SendSlope where L_max is maximum interfering frame size

WCD_equation.base_formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(propagation_delay + switching_delay + transmission_time) + interference_delay + sync_error
WCD_equation.CBS_adjustment: Interference is bounded by maximum frame transmission time of competing flows on same queue, scaled by SendSlope recovery time
WCD_equation.network_calculus: Using arrival curves α(t) = payload/period and service curves β(t) = max(0, R*(t-T)), horizontal deviation gives delay bound

reason.CBS_shaping_model: At each egress port, credit accumulates at SendSlope when queue is non-empty and not transmitting, depletes at IdleSlope during transmission. Maximum delay occurs when credit is most negative and must recover before transmission.

all_parameters_used.CBS_shaping_delay_formula: For each hop, max interference from competing flows considering CBS SendSlope recovery
all_parameters_used.WCD_formula: Sum over all hops of: (transmission_time + switching_delay + propagation_delay + CBS_shaping_delay + sync_error)
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve: Rate-latency curve with rate = IdleSlope and latency from SendSlope drain time
all_parameters_used.network_calculus_approach: Arrival curve α(t) = frame_size + rate*t where rate = frame_size/period; Service curve β(t) = max(0, IdleSlope*(t - latency)); Delay = horizontal deviation between arrival and service curves

WCD_calculation_method.description: For each flow, WCD is computed as the sum of delays at each hop along its path. At each hop, the delay includes: (1) transmission time of the frame, (2) switching delay (1 µs for cut-through), (3) propagation delay (1 µs), (4) CBS shaping delay based on interference from competing flows in the same queue, and (5) time synchronization error (1 µs). The CBS shaping delay accounts for the worst-case scenario where the credit is at its minimum when the frame arrives, requiring recovery at the IdleSlope rate before transmission can begin.
WCD_calculation_method.CBS_shaping_calculation: At each egress port, the maximum credit drain occurs when all competing flows in queue 6 transmit back-to-back. The credit drains at SendSlope (-25 Mbps) during transmission of interfering frames and recovers at IdleSlope (75 Mbps) during idle periods. The worst-case shaping delay is the time needed to recover from maximum negative credit to zero before the flow can transmit.

WCD_calculation_methodology.base_formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(switching_delay + propagation_delay + transmission_time) + CBS_shaping_delay + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation_methodology.CBS_shaping_delay_formula: For each egress port, CBS_delay = sum(competing_frame_sizes) / |SendSlope| when credit exhausted
WCD_calculation_methodology.cut_through_impact: Switching delay is fixed at 1us, independent of frame size

frame_overhead.description: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 for typical calculation

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = transmission_time + propagation_delay + switching_delay + sync_error + CBS_shaping_delay
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping_delay: Depends on credit accumulation/depletion using IdleSlope and SendSlope
WCD_calculation.network_calculus_approach: Arrival curve α(t) = frame_size + rate*t; Service curve β(t) = max(0, IdleSlope*(t-latency)); Delay = horizontal deviation between arrival and service curves
WCD_calculation.simplification: For each hop, CBS introduces variable delay based on credit state, competing flows, and shaper parameters

frame_size_calculation.description: Frame size = Payload + Ethernet overhead (Preamble 8B + Header 14B + CRC 4B + IFG 12B) = Payload + 38B

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = sum(per_hop_CBS_delay) + fixed_delays
WCD_calculation.fixed_delays: fixed_delays = (hop_count - 1) * switching_delay + hop_count * propagation_delay + transmission_time_first_hop + time_sync_error * number_of_switches
WCD_calculation.CBS_burst_delay: For each egress port, CBS introduces delay based on credit accumulation. Delay = (L_max / SendSlope_bps) where L_max is maximum interfering frame size
WCD_calculation.network_calculus_approach: Arrival curve: alpha(t) = frame_size + (t / period) * frame_size. Service curve: beta(t) = max(0, IdleSlope * (t - latency)). Delay = horizontal deviation between arrival and service curves.

F29.service_curve: Rate-latency with rate = IdleSlope = 75 Mbps, latency = switching_delay + max_interference
F29.max_interference_us: Sum of largest frames from competing flows at higher or equal priority transmitted at SendSlope rate
F29.WCD_formula: WCD = hops * (switching_delay + propagation_delay) + sum(max_frame_interference / IdleSlope) + frame_transmission_time + sync_error

WCD_calculation_method.approach: Network Calculus with CBS service curves
WCD_calculation_method.arrival_curve: Token bucket (r, b) where r = frame_size/period, b = frame_size
WCD_calculation_method.service_curve: Rate-latency β(t) = R * [t - T]+ where R = IdleSlope, T = latency including switching delay and interference
WCD_calculation_method.interference_model: At each egress port, account for maximum frame from all competing flows in same queue that could be in transmission when flow arrives
WCD_calculation_method.formula: WCD = Σ(per_hop_delay) where per_hop_delay = switching_delay + propagation_delay + queuing_delay + transmission_time
WCD_calculation_method.total_delay: Sum across all hops + synchronization error

frame_overhead.description: Total frame size = payload + 42 bytes (Ethernet + VLAN + FCS + Preamble + IFG)

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(transmission_delay + switching_delay + propagation_delay + CBS_shaping_delay + interference_delay) + time_sync_error
WCD_calculation.CBS_shaping_delay_per_hop: frame_size_bits / IdleSlope_bps * 1e6 (in µs) - accounts for credit accumulation
WCD_calculation.interference_delay: sum of transmission times of interfering frames from higher or equal priority flows sharing the egress port
WCD_calculation.cut_through_benefit: In cut-through mode, switching begins after header is received, reducing buffering delay
WCD_calculation.network_calculus_approach: Arrival curve α(t) = payload_bits + (t/period) * frame_bits; Service curve β(t) = max(0, IdleSlope * (t - frame_bits/portRate)); Delay = max horizontal distance between α and β

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = sum_over_hops(max(T_tx_i + T_CBS_i) + T_sw + T_prop) + T_sync

where.T_tx_i: Transmission time of frame i = (frame_size_bytes * 8) / bandwidth_bps
where.max_interfering_frame: Largest frame among competing flows at same egress port/queue

WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: Rate-latency curve with rate = IdleSlope and latency = max_frame/|SendSlope|
WCD_calculation.network_calculus_principle: Worst-case delay bounded by arrival curve and service curve convolution

WCD_calculation.equation: WCD = sum(transmission_times) + sum(switching_delays) + sum(propagation_delays) + sum(sync_errors) + sum(interference_delays)

all_parameters_used.overhead_breakdown: Preamble(7) + SFD(1) + DA(6) + SA(6) + VLAN(4) + Type(2) + FCS(4) + IFG(12) = 42 bytes, reduced to 38 for cut-through
all_parameters_used.equation: WCD = Σ(frame_transmission_time) + Σ(switching_delay) + Σ(propagation_delay) + Σ(sync_error) + Σ(CBS_interference_delay)
all_parameters_used.CBS_interference: max_interference = Σ(interfering_frame_sizes) at each hop, delayed by SendSlope recovery

reason.WCD_equation: WCD = sum(delay_at_each_egress_port) + propagation_delays + switching_delays + sync_error + transmission_time_at_source
reason.CBS_delay_equation: delay_port = (burst_bytes * 8) / (idleSlope_rate_Mbps * 1000000) * 1000000, where burst accounts for interfering traffic
reason.frame_size_calculation: frame_size = payload + 38 bytes (Ethernet overhead: preamble 8 + header 14 + CRC 4 + IFG 12)

WCD_calculation.formula: WCD = sum_over_hops(max_burst_transmission_time / IdleSlope + switching_delay + propagation_delay + sync_error)

network_calculus_approach.arrival_curve: Each flow has arrival curve alpha(t) = frame_size_bits + rate * t, where rate = frame_size_bits / period
network_calculus_approach.service_curve: CBS provides rate-latency service curve beta(t) = max(0, IdleSlope * (t - latency)), where latency accounts for switching, propagation, and sync delays
network_calculus_approach.delay_bound: WCD = horizontal distance between arrival curve and service curve = (frame_size_bits / IdleSlope_bps) * 1e6 + fixed_delays
network_calculus_approach.total_delay: sum over all switching hops plus end-station processing
